timeline.text: Welcome to When You’re Carrying Everyone Else’s Problems. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am carrying problems that are not all mine.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep thinking about how to make everyone okay.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I feel responsible when someone I love is struggling.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: Part of me is always searching for a solution.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is holding other people's tension.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am afraid that stepping back would be selfish.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I keep putting my own needs at the end of the list.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that this is exhausting me.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: There is too much weight on my shoulders right now.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can care without carrying everything.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Support is different from taking responsibility.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Other people are allowed to have their own feelings.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can listen without immediately finding a solution.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can release what does not belong to me.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: Resting does not mean I have stopped caring.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can notice where my responsibility ends.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: My needs deserve a place in the room too.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can put down some of this weight.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can offer support from a grounded place.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust others to participate in their own lives.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can ask what kind of support is actually wanted.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can stay connected without losing myself.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel lighter and more separate.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am allowed to protect my time and energy.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can choose compassion without overfunctioning.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I carry what is mine and release the rest.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to return to my own life.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
